verdict.rationale: Fin has a dedicated testing capability documented at fin.ai/testing ("test it across thousands of scenarios before anything goes live") and a specific help article "How to preview and test Fin," directly matching the support-ops need to validate the agent before it faces customers. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the testing workflow and explicit mention of importing historical ticket transcripts as test scenarios rather than only generic 'scenarios'.
